uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: The marked and exit-now values are provisional and are not realized PnL.
The venue stop remains above entry and therefore protects capital but none of the current open profit.
The extension can give back the current profit before an opposite intent, stop, or hard deadline exits.
One prospective HYPE lifecycle cannot establish that the extend policy is economically superior.
The post-soft trailing challengers are descriptive only and cannot submit an order.
A later regime reversal may occur between completed strategy decisions.
falsifier: This decision is technically falsified if the ledger lacks exactly one soft-stage extend event, if the persisted exit plan does not move to the recorded hard deadline, if the venue stop disappears, or if an eligible opposite intent fails to close exactly once. Its economic value is weakened if resolved independent lifecycles show that frozen post-soft or mature-profit trails preserve more after-cost net PnL than native exits without materially truncating winners.

change_proposal.Recommendation: Make no mid-lifecycle parameter change. Preserve the recorded extension, venue stop, eligible-opposite close, and hard deadline while resolving the exact lifecycle.
change_proposal.Why now: The first real soft-hold boundary has executed prospectively and supplies direct evidence about the configured exit controller rather than a simulation.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Exact v51 checkpoint, maximum-hold decision payload, bound execution plan, current venue stop identity, marked economics, completed one-minute path, and frozen post-soft trail challengers.
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: The controller correctly extended a profitable aligned short, but approximately $40 of marked profit remains unprotected by the current loss-side stop.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: HYPE short with provider and canonical TREND_DOWN, 5m TREND_DOWN, 15m TREND_DOWN, and 1m RANGE at the soft decision.
change_proposal.Alternatives considered: Immediate manual close, activate a post-soft trailing exit, move the venue stop, exit on non-executable regime opposition, or preserve the native prospective contract.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Avoid contaminating the prospective exit test while retaining the opportunity for the trend-aligned winner to continue.
change_proposal.Main risks and failure modes: Profit giveback, endpoint selection bias, stop slippage, regime transition before the next completed decision, and overlearning from one winner.
change_proposal.Validation completed: Exact decision identity and timestamp, one-and-only-one soft decision, score-versus-threshold, bound hard deadline, stop ownership, live process health, and post-soft challenger state.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Actual exit reason and fill, exact realized fees/funding/slippage, final MFE/MAE/giveback, native-versus-predeclared challenger deltas, and additional independent lifecycles.
change_proposal.Success metrics: No duplicate soft decision; venue stop remains owned; eligible opposite closes exactly once without same-cycle reversal; hard deadline is honored if still open; and final lifecycle accounting reconciles exactly.
change_proposal.Failure / rollback triggers: Lost protection, duplicate or absent exit action, accounting/profile mismatch, or repeated resolved evidence that native extension destroys after-cost edge versus a predeclared alternative.
change_proposal.Confidence level: High on the technical decision and observed telemetry; medium that extension was directionally consistent at this boundary; low on long-run economic superiority from one unresolved lifecycle.
change_proposal.Explicit approval requested: No approval requested because no live change is proposed.
